# Dr Ganesh Sivasankara

> Consultant Anaesthetist, and lately a builder of small teaching tools with AI.

Consultant Anaesthetist and Section Head of Paediatric Anaesthesia, King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Centre, Riyadh.

I have worked as an anaesthetist in the UK and Saudi Arabia for more than twenty-five years, mostly in paediatric and obstetric anaesthesia, and I write and teach about the evidence behind what we do every day in the operating theatre.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/): who I am and who this site is for
- [My work](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/work.html): the free teaching apps and the writing
- [About](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/about.html): clinical record, roles held, qualifications, teaching and what I am doing now

## Teaching apps

- [Reading the EEG](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/reading-the-eeg/): a course on the anaesthetic EEG for anaesthesia residents, built around a live trace and spectrogram.
- [Reading the clot](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/reading-the-clot/): the TEG and ROTEM trace for anaesthetists, the normal trace beside each defect with what to give for it, plus drills and a plot of your own numbers.
- [Cannulation geometry](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/cannulation-geometry/): how insertion angle and catheter length decide how much of a cannula ends up inside the vein.
- [The magnet](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/the-magnet/): MRI safety physics for the anaesthetist in ten cards, the field drawn as iron filings and computed from the magnet.
- [How the AI you use works](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/how-the-ai-works/): a dictionary of the terms behind the AI tools clinicians already use, one card per term.
- [Before you sign](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/before-you-sign/): a three-minute exercise in checking an AI scribe's note from a pre-anaesthesia consultation before signing it.
- [Spoken Saudi Arabic for anaesthetists](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/spoken-saudi-arabic/): 102 phrases from the anaesthetic room to recovery, each spoken by a Saudi voice, with listen-and-repeat, a listening quiz and what patients say back.
- [The disagreement checker, blood pressure targets](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/bp-targets/): ten questions on blood pressure targets in neonates and children under anaesthesia, each put to six AI models three times, with every answer drawn on one scale.
- [The disagreement checker, GLP-1 agonists and SGLT2 inhibitors](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/glp1-sglt2/): the same method on what to do about GLP-1 agonists and SGLT2 inhibitors before surgery.
- [Guideline tracker](https://ganeshsivasankara.com/guideline-tracker/): what has changed in anaesthesia guidelines over the last two years, with links to the full text.
